formula: For each serial seed-group process: median matched-length incremental HF wall per case * number of cases + one 180s process/model-load margin. Range uses 800–1600 seconds/case plus one 180s margin per process. No overlap with adaptive run, device speed-ranking, or serving measurement.
limitations: Three current cases only; add any later root-adjudicated native-positive short-TT cases to their matching positive-seed group and recompute. HF seed is a fresh HF RNG trial, not an exact TT sample replay. A progressing or capped result remains inconclusive; consider >=2x extension before closure.
